release.note_zh: 本页发布脱敏动作指导、前端示意动画，以及已人工审核的匿名 Avatar 自生成演示视频。真人源视频、真人预览图和未批准 landmark 不公开。摄像头评分只上传浏览器提取的匿名运动关键点。
release.note_en: This page publishes de-identified action guidance, procedural schematics, and manually reviewed self-generated anonymous Avatar demonstrations. Source-person videos, previews, and unapproved landmarks are not public. Camera scoring uploads browser-extracted anonymous motion landmarks only.

contracts.summary_zh: 用食指沿嘴角向下滑动模拟口水，同时配合馋嘴的口部状态。
contracts.summary_en: Slide one index finger down from the corner of the mouth to suggest drool, with a matching craving expression.

ordered_sequence.label_en: Slide the index finger down from the mouth corner
ordered_sequence.detail_zh: 一手食指沿嘴角向下滑动，完成“口水”过程。
ordered_sequence.detail_en: One index finger travels downward along the mouth corner to complete the drool action.

contracts.summary_zh: 双手从喉部两侧同时向外移动，配合头部左右晃动和张嘴状态。
contracts.summary_en: Move both hands outward from the throat while the head sways side to side and the mouth opens.

ordered_sequence.label_en: Move both hands outward from the throat
ordered_sequence.detail_zh: 双手拇指和食指从喉部两边同时向外移出，表示发声。
ordered_sequence.detail_en: Thumb-and-index hand shapes move outward from both sides of the throat to suggest vocalization.

features_zh: 拇指和食指保持相应手形

contracts.summary_zh: 先双手虚握并向前推动购物车，再按左、右、左、右顺序抓取商品各一次，左右各重复两遍，最后回到虚握。
contracts.summary_en: Grip and push an imaginary cart, then reach left, right, left, right, and return to the cart grip; each side is used twice.

ordered_sequence.detail_zh: 双手虚握、虎口相对、手背向上，形成准备状态。
ordered_sequence.detail_en: Both hands form an imaginary handle with the web spaces facing each other and backs of hands upward.

ordered_sequence.detail_zh: 双手向前推动，进入选购动作。
ordered_sequence.detail_en: Both hands move forward into the shopping action.

ordered_sequence.detail_zh: 从虚握状态向左侧抓取商品。
ordered_sequence.detail_en: Reach from the grip toward an item on the left.

ordered_sequence.detail_zh: 从左侧返回并向右侧抓取商品。
ordered_sequence.detail_en: Return from the left and reach toward an item on the right.

ordered_sequence.detail_zh: 第二次向左侧抓取商品。
ordered_sequence.detail_en: Reach left for the second time.

ordered_sequence.detail_zh: 第二次向右侧抓取商品。
ordered_sequence.detail_en: Reach right for the second time.

ordered_sequence.detail_zh: 抓取完成后回到双手虚握状态。
ordered_sequence.detail_en: Return to the two-hand cart grip after the reaches.

contracts.summary_zh: 双手斜立、指尖相抵形成船头，并保持这一关系整体向前移动表示航行。
contracts.summary_en: Form a ship bow with both hands tilted and fingertips touching, then move the shape forward to suggest sailing.

ordered_sequence.detail_zh: 保持船头形状并向前行驶。
ordered_sequence.detail_en: Keep the bow shape while travelling forward.

contracts.summary_zh: 一手虚握且虎口朝内表示握住公交车把手，随后前后晃动两次。
contracts.summary_en: Hold an imaginary bus strap with one hand, then move the gripping hand forward and backward twice.

ordered_sequence.detail_zh: 建立乘车握把手的准备状态。
ordered_sequence.detail_en: Establish the hand-grip posture for riding a bus.

ordered_sequence.label_en: Rock forward and back — first time
ordered_sequence.detail_zh: 虚握的手随公交车运动前后移动第一次。
ordered_sequence.detail_en: Rock the gripping hand once with the bus motion.

ordered_sequence.label_en: Rock forward and back — second time
ordered_sequence.detail_zh: 虚握的手完成第二次前后移动。
ordered_sequence.detail_en: Complete a second forward-backward rock.

contracts.summary_zh: 先在前额形成“王”字，再双手五指弯曲、指尖朝下向前下方有力按动，模拟兽爪。
contracts.summary_en: First form the character-like tiger mark at the forehead, then bend both hands into claws and press forcefully forward and down.

ordered_sequence.label_en: Form the tiger mark at the forehead
ordered_sequence.detail_zh: 先在前额形成老虎王字花纹。
ordered_sequence.detail_en: Create the tiger-mark shape at the forehead first.

ordered_sequence.label_zh: 双手兽爪向前下方按动
ordered_sequence.label_en: Press both claw hands forward and down
ordered_sequence.detail_zh: 随后双手弯曲五指并向前下方有力按动。
ordered_sequence.detail_en: Then bend all fingers into claws and press forward and downward with emphasis.

features_en: fingers jointly form the tiger mark

contracts.summary_zh: 一手撮合、指尖朝上形成花苞，手向上移动的同时逐渐张开表示开花。
contracts.summary_en: Gather one hand with fingertips up to form a bud, then move it upward while gradually opening to show blooming.

ordered_sequence.detail_zh: 一手撮合、指尖朝上形成花苞准备。
ordered_sequence.detail_en: Gather one hand with fingertips up to establish the bud.

ordered_sequence.detail_zh: 手向上移动的同时逐渐张开，完成绽放。
ordered_sequence.detail_en: Move upward while gradually opening the fingers to complete the bloom.

contracts.summary_zh: 先在嘴前撮合拇指和食指表示鸡嘴，再双手形成鸡蛋椭圆并分开完成打蛋。
contracts.summary_en: Make a beak in front of the mouth, form an egg-shaped oval with both hands, and separate them to crack the egg.

ordered_sequence.detail_zh: 拇指和食指撮合放在嘴前形成鸟喙。
ordered_sequence.detail_en: Pinch thumb and index finger in front of the mouth as a bird beak.

ordered_sequence.detail_zh: 双手食指和拇指组成鸡蛋大小的椭圆。
ordered_sequence.detail_en: Use both index fingers and thumbs to form an egg-sized oval.

ordered_sequence.detail_zh: 双手分开，完成打开鸡蛋的动作。
ordered_sequence.detail_en: Separate both hands to complete the cracking action.

features_en: hand is in front of the mouth
both hands jointly form an oval

contracts.summary_zh: 双手收拇指并平摊四指形成签子手形，随后左右翻动烤串两下。
contracts.summary_en: Fold in both thumbs and spread four fingers to form skewers, then turn the barbecue twice from side to side.

ordered_sequence.detail_zh: 双手收起拇指、平摊四指，建立签子形状。
ordered_sequence.detail_en: Fold both thumbs in and spread four fingers to establish the skewer shape.

ordered_sequence.detail_zh: 双手左右翻动完成第一次翻转。
ordered_sequence.detail_en: Turn both hands side to side once.

ordered_sequence.detail_zh: 双手左右翻动完成第二次翻转。
ordered_sequence.detail_en: Complete a second side-to-side turn.

features_en: four fingers spread on both hands

contracts.summary_zh: 先双手K手形交替向前绕圈，再一手撮合从外向额头靠近并按向额头。
contracts.summary_en: Alternate two K-hand shapes in forward circles, then bring a gathered hand toward and press it to the forehead.

ordered_sequence.label_en: Alternate forward circles with two K shapes
ordered_sequence.detail_zh: 两个K手形交替向前绕圈，表示科学交流。
ordered_sequence.detail_en: Two K-like hand shapes alternate in forward circles.

ordered_sequence.label_zh: 撮合手从外向额头靠近
ordered_sequence.label_en: Bring a gathered hand toward the forehead
ordered_sequence.detail_zh: 五指撮合、指尖朝内，从外部向额头靠近。
ordered_sequence.detail_en: Bring a gathered hand, fingertips inward, from outside toward the forehead.

ordered_sequence.detail_zh: 将撮合手按向额头，完成知识进入脑袋的动作。
ordered_sequence.detail_en: Press the gathered hand to the forehead to complete the knowledge gesture.

features_en: index and middle fingers form an L-like shape

contracts.summary_zh: 先用一手牛角形抵太阳穴表示牛，再虎口朝上、五指弯曲并挤压向下表示挤奶。
contracts.summary_en: Make a horn shape at the temple for cow, then bend the fingers with the web space up and squeeze downward for milking.

ordered_sequence.label_en: Place a horn shape at the temple
ordered_sequence.detail_zh: 一手模仿牛角，抵在太阳穴表示牛。
ordered_sequence.detail_en: Place one horn-like hand at the temple to represent a cow.

ordered_sequence.detail_zh: 虎口朝上、五指弯曲，同时挤压并向下移动。
ordered_sequence.detail_en: Keep the web space up, bend the fingers, and squeeze downward together.

features_en: squeeze and downward motion are simultaneous

contracts.summary_zh: 双手拇指表示两个人的头，两个拇指相碰两次表示亲密关系。
contracts.summary_en: Use both thumbs as two heads and bring them together twice to express closeness.

ordered_sequence.detail_zh: 先建立两个拇指人头的相对关系。
ordered_sequence.detail_en: Establish the relative position of the two thumb-heads.

ordered_sequence.detail_zh: 两个拇指头互相碰撞第一次。
ordered_sequence.detail_en: Bring the two thumb-heads together once.

ordered_sequence.detail_zh: 两个拇指头互相碰撞第二次。
ordered_sequence.detail_en: Bring them together a second time.

features_zh: 两根拇指分别作为两个人的头

contracts.summary_zh: 双手虚握方向盘，并保持双手相对关系协同左右转动。
contracts.summary_en: Hold an imaginary steering wheel with both hands and turn it left and right together.

ordered_sequence.detail_zh: 双手建立方向盘握持准备状态。
ordered_sequence.detail_en: Establish the two-hand steering-wheel grip.

ordered_sequence.label_zh: 双手协同左右转动方向盘
ordered_sequence.label_en: Turn the wheel left and right
ordered_sequence.detail_zh: 双手共同完成左右转动。
ordered_sequence.detail_en: Both hands turn the wheel together from side to side.

contracts.summary_zh: 一手五指形成方块状车身侧面，保持车身形状向前移动一次。
contracts.summary_en: Shape one hand like the side of a car, keep that shape, and move it forward once.

ordered_sequence.label_en: Form the side of a car
ordered_sequence.detail_zh: 一手五指成方块形，建立车身侧面。
ordered_sequence.detail_en: Use one hand to form a block-like car side.

ordered_sequence.detail_zh: 保持车身形状向前移动一次。
ordered_sequence.detail_en: Keep the car shape while moving forward once.

features_en: the car shape is maintained while moving

contracts.summary_zh: 双手食指形成“人”字，再从胸前顺时针环绕一圈表示很多人。
contracts.summary_en: Form the character-like shape for a person with both index fingers, then circle clockwise once from the chest to suggest many people.

ordered_sequence.detail_zh: 先摆出手语仿字“人”。
ordered_sequence.detail_en: First form the character-like shape for a person.

ordered_sequence.detail_zh: 从胸前出发顺时针转动一圈表示多人。
ordered_sequence.detail_en: Start at the chest and circle clockwise once to suggest many people.

features_zh: 双手食指共同形成“人”字
features_en: both index fingers form the people shape
the start position is at the chest

contracts.summary_zh: 双手拇指和食指形成大圆树干，在三个不同位置分别自下而上完成树形动作。
contracts.summary_en: Make large circular trunks with both thumbs and index fingers, moving upward at three different positions to suggest many trees.

ordered_sequence.detail_zh: 在一个位置完成一次树形动作。
ordered_sequence.detail_en: Complete one tree action at the first location.

ordered_sequence.detail_zh: 在第二个不同位置完成一次树形动作。
ordered_sequence.detail_en: Complete one tree action at a second location.

ordered_sequence.detail_zh: 在第三个不同位置完成一次树形动作。
ordered_sequence.detail_en: Complete one tree action at a third location.

features_zh: 双手拇指和食指形成大圆形
三处位置各保持一次树形
features_en: thumbs and index fingers form large circles
the tree shape is held at each of three locations

contracts.summary_zh: 右手食指和中指模拟双腿，先弯曲蓄力，再相对左手地面快速伸直向上弹跳。
contracts.summary_en: Use the right index and middle fingers as legs: bend first, then extend and jump upward relative to the left-hand ground.

ordered_sequence.detail_zh: 右手食指和中指模拟双腿并先弯曲蓄力。
ordered_sequence.detail_en: Bend the right index and middle fingers as legs to load the jump.

ordered_sequence.detail_zh: 右手两指快速伸直并向上弹跳。
ordered_sequence.detail_en: Quickly extend the two fingers and jump upward.

features_zh: 右手食指和中指模拟双腿
features_en: right index and middle fingers are legs
right hand jumps upward relative to it

contracts.summary_zh: 辅助手竖起食指表示香蕉，主手沿该食指从上向下完成剥皮动作。
contracts.summary_en: Hold one index finger upright as the banana, then slide the other hand downward along it to peel.

ordered_sequence.label_en: Peel downward along the banana finger
ordered_sequence.detail_zh: 右手沿左手竖直食指由上向下完成剥皮。
ordered_sequence.detail_en: Move the active hand from top to bottom along the upright reference index finger.

features_zh: 辅助手食指竖直且稳定
features_en: supporting index finger stays upright and stable
active hand peels downward along it

contracts.summary_zh: 双手贴腹、伸出拇指和食指并向两侧用力拉开，同时保持抬头挺胸和坚毅表情。
contracts.summary_en: Start near the abdomen with thumb-and-index shapes, pull both hands outward with strength, and keep the head up, chest open, and expression firm.

ordered_sequence.label_zh: 双手从腹部向两侧拉开
ordered_sequence.label_en: Pull both hands outward from the abdomen
ordered_sequence.detail_zh: 拇指和食指平着用力拉开，表示把胆撑大。
ordered_sequence.detail_en: Pull the thumb-and-index shapes outward to show making the courage bigger.

contracts.summary_zh: 双手向两边移动，同时两根关键手指的间距逐渐变窄，形成弯月轮廓。
contracts.summary_en: Move both hands outward while the gap between the key fingers gradually narrows to form a crescent outline.

ordered_sequence.detail_zh: 双手向两侧分开形成月亮动作过程。
ordered_sequence.detail_en: Separate both hands to create the moon movement.

features_zh: 两根手指距离逐渐变窄
features_en: the gap between two fingers narrows gradually
the hands form a crescent outline

contracts.summary_zh: 辅助手拇指模拟人头，主手食指相对参照向左、向右完成指挥动作。
contracts.summary_en: Use one thumb as a person’s head while the other index finger directs first left and then right relative to it.

ordered_sequence.detail_zh: 右手食指相对左手拇指人头完成向左指挥。
ordered_sequence.detail_en: Direct left with the active index finger relative to the supporting thumb-head.

ordered_sequence.detail_zh: 右手食指相对左手拇指人头完成向右指挥。
ordered_sequence.detail_en: Direct right relative to the supporting thumb-head.

features_zh: 辅助手拇指作为人头参照
主手食指相对参照移动
features_en: supporting thumb is the head reference
active index finger moves relative to it
